giga.name=Arduino Giga R1
giga.build.core=arduino
giga.build.crossprefix=arm-zephyr-eabi-
giga.build.compiler_path={runtime.tools.arm-zephyr-eabi-1.0.1.path}/bin/

giga.menu.debug.false=Standard
giga.menu.debug.true=Debug
giga.menu.debug.true.build.zsk_args.debug=-debug

giga.menu.link_mode.dynamic=Dynamic
giga.menu.link_mode.static=Static
giga.menu.link_mode.static.build.link_mode=static
giga.menu.link_mode.static.upload.extension=bin-zsk.bin

giga.build.zephyr_target=arduino_giga_r1//m7
giga.build.zephyr_args=--shield arduino_giga_display_shield
giga.build.zephyr_hals=hal_stm32 hal_infineon
giga.build.zephyr_toolchain=arm-zephyr-eabi
giga.build.variant=arduino_giga_r1_stm32h747xx_m7
giga.build.artifact=zephyr_main

giga.build.extra_flags=
giga.build.postbuild.cmd="{tools.imgtool.path}/{tools.imgtool.cmd}" exit
giga.build.board=GIGA
giga.upload_port.0.vid=0x2341
giga.upload_port.0.pid=0x0666

giga.upload.tool=dfu-util
giga.upload.tool.default=dfu-util
giga.upload.protocol=
giga.upload.transport=
giga.upload.interface=0
giga.upload.use_1200bps_touch=true
giga.upload.wait_for_upload_port=true
giga.upload.native_usb=true

giga.bootloader.tool=dfu-util
giga.bootloader.tool.default=dfu-util
giga.bootloader.pid=0x0366
giga.bootloader.interface=0
giga.bootloader.file=zephyr-{build.variant}.bin
giga.bootloader.address=0x08040000

giga.debug.tool=gdb
giga.debug.server.openocd.scripts.0=interface/{programmer.protocol}.cfg
giga.debug.server.openocd.scripts.1={programmer.transport_script}
giga.debug.server.openocd.scripts.2=target/stm32h7x_dual_bank.cfg
giga.debug.cortex-debug.custom.request=attach
giga.debug.svd_file={runtime.platform.path}/svd/STM32H747_CM7.svd

nano_chandler.name=Arduino Nano Chandler
nano_chandler.build.core=arduino
nano_chandler.build.crossprefix=arm-zephyr-eabi-
nano_chandler.build.compiler_path={runtime.tools.arm-zephyr-eabi-1.0.1.path}/bin/

nano_chandler.menu.link_mode.dynamic=Dynamic
nano_chandler.menu.link_mode.static=Static
nano_chandler.menu.link_mode.static.build.link_mode=static
nano_chandler.menu.link_mode.static.upload.extension=bin-zsk.bin

nano_chandler.build.zephyr_target=arduino_nano_chandler
nano_chandler.build.zephyr_args=
nano_chandler.build.zephyr_hals=hal_microchip
nano_chandler.build.zephyr_toolchain=arm-zephyr-eabi
nano_chandler.build.artifact=zephyr_main
nano_chandler.build.variant=arduino_nano_chandler_pic32ck1025gc01144
nano_chandler.build.extra_flags=
nano_chandler.build.board=NANO_CHANDLER

# Multi-image MCUboot: loader and sketch are SEPARATE images uploaded
# independently to slot0 and slot2. No combined bundle is produced.
#
# Multi-image MCUboot: no combined bundle, so build.ota.magic is unset and
# postobjcopy.3/.4 (bundle/delta generation) are effectively no-ops.
# build.ota.offset is kept for reference (sketch partition at 0x48000).
nano_chandler.build.ota.magic=
nano_chandler.build.ota.offset=0x48000
nano_chandler.build.ota.mcuboot_args=

nano_chandler.vid.0=0x2341
nano_chandler.pid.0=0x007e
nano_chandler.upload_port.0.vid=0x2341
nano_chandler.upload_port.0.pid=0x007e
nano_chandler.upload.target=pic32ck1025sg01144
# The GC01144 has no CMSIS-Pack; the pin/die-compatible SG part is the stand-in.
# pack.debug_sequences.enable=false is required to connect at all (pyOCD's
# J-Link backend can't issue the raw DAP_SWJ_Sequence the pack's DebugPortSetup
# needs); connect_mode=halt because under-reset makes flash erase time out; and
# reset_type=sw_sysresetreq because disabling debug sequences also disables this
# chip's pack-defined ResetSystem.
nano_chandler.pyocd.extra_flags=-O pack.debug_sequences.enable=false -O connect_mode=halt -O reset_type=sw_sysresetreq --script "{build.variant.path}/pyocd_user.py"

# Uploads speak mcumgr/SMP to MCUboot's serial recovery mode over USB CDC-ACM.
#
# The sequence, all of it automatic: arduino-cli opens the port at 1200 baud,
# the running loader sees the rate change and arms the shared cookie before
# resetting (variants/.../variant.c:_on_1200_bps), MCUboot comes up, finds the
# cookie and stays in recovery, and the board re-enumerates with the PID below.
# wait_for_upload_port makes arduino-cli wait for that second port and hand it
# to the recipe. A physical double-tap of reset does the same thing by hand.
#
# One image is written, not two: the artifact carries loader AND sketch, so
# there is no "flash the loader only if its version differs" step any more.
nano_chandler.upload.tool=zephyr-smp
nano_chandler.upload.tool.default=zephyr-smp
nano_chandler.upload.protocol=
nano_chandler.upload.transport=
nano_chandler.upload.vid=0x2341
# MCUboot in recovery, i.e. CONFIG_CDC_ACM_SERIAL_PID in
# variants/.../mcuboot.conf. 0x007e above is the running loader.
nano_chandler.upload.pid=0x018e
# This board's bootloader has CONFIG_BOOT_LINE_BUFS=16, but smpmgr's frame
# sizing from line-buffers × line-length can exceed CONFIG_BOOT_SERIAL_MAX_-
# RECEIVE_SIZE (1024) if we tell it 16. The platform default (8) keeps the
# decoded frame under 1024 and the throughput difference is negligible (flash-
# programming-bound, not turnaround-bound), so no override here.
nano_chandler.upload.use_1200bps_touch=true
nano_chandler.upload.wait_for_upload_port=true
nano_chandler.upload.native_usb=true

# burn-bootloader writes the LOADER into slot0 over SWD - the way back for a
# board whose PFM is empty or corrupt and which therefore cannot be reached over
# USB at all. It does not install MCUboot: that lives in BFM, whose write-protect
# bits re-arm at every reset and which the borrowed flash algorithm cannot
# program, so it stays tools/chandler_flasher/chandler_flasher.py's job.
#
# `pyocd load` does write PFM correctly - verified byte-for-byte 2026-08-18,
# against an earlier claim in this tree that it hangs. What it does need is the
# user script in pyocd.extra_flags above, which normalises SWAP.PFSWAP before
# the first flash access; without it, on a board whose BFM slot has been
# promoted, the image lands in the other panel and the read-back agrees with it.
nano_chandler.bootloader.tool=pyocd
nano_chandler.bootloader.tool.default=pyocd
nano_chandler.bootloader.file=zephyr-{build.variant}.bin
nano_chandler.bootloader.target={upload.target}
nano_chandler.bootloader.address=0x0C000000
# The artifact is the MCUboot-headered image, a raw binary, so pyocd needs the
# address (see bootloader.load_at in platform.txt).
nano_chandler.bootloader.load_at=@{bootloader.address}

##############################################################################################################

nano_chandler_monica.name=Arduino Nano Chandler Monica
nano_chandler_monica.build.core=arduino
nano_chandler_monica.build.crossprefix=arm-zephyr-eabi-
nano_chandler_monica.build.compiler_path={runtime.tools.arm-zephyr-eabi-1.0.1.path}/bin/

nano_chandler_monica.menu.link_mode.dynamic=Dynamic
nano_chandler_monica.menu.link_mode.static=Static
nano_chandler_monica.menu.link_mode.static.build.link_mode=static
nano_chandler_monica.menu.link_mode.static.upload.extension=bin-zsk.bin

nano_chandler_monica.build.zephyr_target=arduino_nano_chandler
# Monica has no Zephyr board variant of its own: it is the bare Nano Chandler
# board plus the "nano_chandler_monica" shield (which adds the ESP8266 node),
# plus a Kconfig/devicetree delta applied on top of the shared variant files.
# EXTRA_DTC_OVERLAY_FILE is applied after DTC_OVERLAY_FILE - and after the
# shield - so it is the only place the carrier can override the bare module.
# Paths are relative to the 'loader' application directory, like debug.conf.
nano_chandler_monica.build.zephyr_args=--shield nano_chandler_monica -- -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE=../variants/arduino_nano_chandler_pic32ck1025gc01144/monica.conf -DEXTRA_DTC_OVERLAY_FILE=../variants/arduino_nano_chandler_pic32ck1025gc01144/monica.overlay
nano_chandler_monica.build.zephyr_hals=hal_microchip
nano_chandler_monica.build.zephyr_toolchain=arm-zephyr-eabi
nano_chandler_monica.build.artifact=zephyr_main
# Shared with the bare 'nano_chandler' board: the two differ only by shield.
# Whichever board is built last owns the shared artifacts under this directory
# (llext-edk/, syms-*.ld, tls-syms.S) and firmwares/zephyr-<variant>.*.
nano_chandler_monica.build.variant=arduino_nano_chandler_pic32ck1025gc01144
nano_chandler_monica.build.extra_flags=
nano_chandler_monica.build.board=NANO_CHANDLER_MONICA

# OTA: same layout as the bare module (they share the variant and its partition
# table), only the magic differs - it follows the carrier's own USB PID.
# Monica's loader is ~281K of the 288K available before the sketch offset,
# because it carries the WiFi stack too; if it grows past that, the sketch build
# fails with "loader exceeds offset".
nano_chandler_monica.build.ota.magic=
nano_chandler_monica.build.ota.offset=0x48000
nano_chandler_monica.build.ota.mcuboot_args=

nano_chandler_monica.vid.0=0x2341
nano_chandler_monica.pid.0=0x008e
nano_chandler_monica.upload_port.0.vid=0x2341
nano_chandler_monica.upload_port.0.pid=0x008e
nano_chandler_monica.upload.target=pic32ck1025sg01144
nano_chandler_monica.pyocd.extra_flags=-O pack.debug_sequences.enable=false -O connect_mode=halt -O reset_type=sw_sysresetreq --script "{build.variant.path}/pyocd_user.py"

# Same upload path as the bare module - see the comment on nano_chandler above.
# The two boards share the variant, the partition table and one BFM image, so
# they also share the recovery VID/PID.
nano_chandler_monica.upload.tool=zephyr-smp
nano_chandler_monica.upload.tool.default=zephyr-smp
nano_chandler_monica.upload.protocol=
nano_chandler_monica.upload.transport=
nano_chandler_monica.upload.vid=0x2341
nano_chandler_monica.upload.pid=0x018e
# Same as nano_chandler above: CONFIG_BOOT_LINE_BUFS=16 but platform default
# of 8 is used to stay within CONFIG_BOOT_SERIAL_MAX_RECEIVE_SIZE (1024).
nano_chandler_monica.upload.use_1200bps_touch=true
nano_chandler_monica.upload.wait_for_upload_port=true
nano_chandler_monica.upload.native_usb=true

# burn-bootloader writes the LOADER into slot0 over SWD - the way back for a
# board whose PFM is empty or corrupt and which therefore cannot be reached over
# USB at all. It does not install MCUboot: that lives in BFM, whose write-protect
# bits re-arm at every reset and which the borrowed flash algorithm cannot
# program, so it stays tools/chandler_flasher/chandler_flasher.py's job.
#
# `pyocd load` does write PFM correctly - verified byte-for-byte 2026-08-18,
# against an earlier claim in this tree that it hangs. What it does need is the
# user script in pyocd.extra_flags above, which normalises SWAP.PFSWAP before
# the first flash access; without it, on a board whose BFM slot has been
# promoted, the image lands in the other panel and the read-back agrees with it.
nano_chandler_monica.bootloader.tool=pyocd
nano_chandler_monica.bootloader.tool.default=pyocd
nano_chandler_monica.bootloader.file=zephyr-{build.variant}.bin
nano_chandler_monica.bootloader.target={upload.target}
nano_chandler_monica.bootloader.address=0x0C000000
# The artifact is the MCUboot-headered image, a raw binary, so pyocd needs the
# address (see bootloader.load_at in platform.txt).
nano_chandler_monica.bootloader.load_at=@{bootloader.address}
